# Why the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick order parameter has no gaps

> Why the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick order parameter has no gaps, by OpenAI (the proof and its Lean) and Will Cook, using AI (the three papers), read beside its Lean. The proof and its Lean are OpenAI’s. Hong-Bin Chen first proved full support in a July 2026 paper, and the earlier results are credited in the papers.

The links from the papers to the Lean, the plain titles, the reading notes and the comparisons were made with AI. No mathematician has reviewed them.

## Read

- [Short paper](https://wcook04.github.io/library/qaoa-sk/)

## Data

All data is static JSON under https://wcook04.github.io/library/qaoa-sk/edition/. Start at edition/index.json: it maps API routes to files.

The Lean index has 349 modules and 3,458 declarations.
